title: Mixed-mode cyclic cohesive paths, energy lifecycle and portable state
purpose: Verify complete local jump extrema, ordered closed non-proportional paths, cohesive GI/GII variation, BK interaction, atomic cycle and generalized-work transactions, global cycle-jump consumption, material-aware fields, MPI assembly and cross-rank-count restart.
physics: Fixed-path proportional and ordered non-proportional mixed-mode cyclic cohesive degradation

execution.command: python -m pytest -q tests/test_fatigue_fracture.py tests/test_global_cohesive_residual.py && mpirun -n 2 python -m pytest -q tests/test_parallel_cohesive.py && mpirun -n 2 python tests/portable_mixed_cyclic_cohesive_driver.py write /tmp/agentfem-mixed-cyclic && python tests/portable_mixed_cyclic_cohesive_driver.py read /tmp/agentfem-mixed-cyclic
execution.evidence: Pure-mode, proportional mixed and ordered-path material points, a real paired-facet public force, a global station-resolved controller, an atomic generalized-work ledger, a two-rank sparse-owner interface and a two-rank-to-one-rank physical-key checkpoint exercise the same replaceable law contract.

observables: True local valley and peak jump vectors rather than independent component extrema.
Local cohesive GI and GII energy ranges, mode fraction, BK critical energy, threshold and normalized range.
Monotonic, fatigue and combined damage with separate dissipated-energy fields.
Accepted cycle count, local load ratio, rollback state and physical-facet checkpoint identity.
Serial and distributed standard interface fields attached to the public cohesive force.
Ordered path length, reversal count and station count.
Named reference-point, prescribed-motion, MPC/weak/contact and natural-load work channels plus material-energy increments.
acceptance: Pure Mode-I has zero GII range and pure Mode-II has zero GI range.
BK mixed critical energy equals its analytical expression and is invariant under a tangential basis rotation.
Peak/valley paths with excessive mode-mix change or shear-direction reversal are rejected rather than silently reduced.
One fixed vector-extrema cycle jump matches repeated exact cycle transactions within numerical tolerance.
Rollback and interrupted global restart preserve every vector and scalar state field.
Two MPI ranks consume the vector law and expose fatigue evidence, and their physical-facet state restores in reordered one-rank execution.
A non-proportional closed path preserves station order, matches exact repeated cycles under a fixed path, and survives rollback/restart.
Cycle-block energy imbalance rejects atomically without committing cohesive, field, cycle or energy-ledger state.
limitations: The local cohesive energy channels are material drivers, not J-integral or VCCT structural energy-release rates.
Non-proportional loading requires explicitly resolved ordered stations; an unresolved continuous waveform is not reconstructed from extrema.
The DCB/ENF/MMB structural benchmark family is a separate verification contract; no cylinder or experimental prediction is implied here.
